segments.text: Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I have moving and handling training and use a hoist.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: We always work in pairs.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: In the dementia unit, residents became agitated at the end of the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they want to eat.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I did 3 years of nights and also weekends.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I saw a bruise on a resident's arm.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: She made the safeguarding report.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: Thank you for considering my application.
segments.author: draft

segments.text: Yours sincerely, Ana

sources.text: Chamome Ana. Eu trabalho há três anos num lar em Leeds, comecei em outubro de dois mil e vinte e três. Tenho a formação da medicação e faço medication round da manhã para dezoito residentes. No fim do do turno, escrevo as daily notes em inglês e assino a folha da medicação. Antes do turno, leio o care plan de cada residente e faço o que lá está. Tenho a formação de moving and handling, uso grua e trabalhamosamos sempre em dupla. Na unidade de demência, os residentes ficavam agitados ao fim do dia, por isso nós, a equipa toda, passámos o jantar para mais cedo. Eu fiz cartões com fotografias da comida para cada pessoa poder apontar o que quer comer. Fiz três anos de noites e também fins de semana. Uma noite, vi uma nódoa negra no braço de uma residente. Registei e contei logo à enfermeira de serviço e ela fez a participação de safeguarding.

Para mim, dignidade é bater à porta antes de entrar, explicar o que vou fazer antes da higiene pessoal e fechar sempre as cortinas. E respeito a cultura e a religião de cada pessoa, pergunto o que quer comer, como quer ser tratada e se prefere ser ajudada por uma mulher.

documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.question: Supporting evidence (application form). The council's advice: "refer to the job profile in the 'supporting evidence' section so the hiring manager can see relevant examples of the qualities they are looking for". The job profile adds: "You should use this information to make the best of your application by identifying some specific pieces of work you may have undertaken in any of these areas."

requirements.text: Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.
Knowledge of keeping people safe from harm or abuse.
Knowledge of long term health & social care conditions e.g. cognitive impairment, Dementia, physical, learning and sensory disabilities
Experience of moving & handling people.
Experience of Administration of Medication
Ability to understand health care and social care assessments and support plans.
Ability to complete daily and medication record sheets
Ability to work with others in a team.
Ability to use own initiative to find solutions for routine day to day service delivery problems
Requirement to work evenings and weekends on a rota basis as part of 24 hour/ 7 day service

documents.limitNote: The advert, job description and council advice state no word limit; 500 words is a working guide for this demo, not the council's limit.

questions.text: Pensando nos cartões com fotografias da comida que fez no lar em Leeds, como é que dar a cada pessoa uma forma de apontar o que queria comer a ajudou a tratar as pessoas de forma igual e com dignidade?
questions.why: The form asks for your awareness and understanding of equality, dignity and human rights; your notes describe making the cards but do not explain what you understood about choice, equality or dignity.
questions.english: Thinking about the food photograph cards you made at the care home in Leeds, how did giving each person a way to point to what they wanted to eat help you treat people equally and with dignity?
